title: Fritz
summary: A private iPhone care companion that turns fast household logging into a trustworthy shared memory, explainable patterns, and calm next steps.
intro: Fritz is a native household pilot for recording a puppy’s care in seconds, coordinating handoffs, and learning from evidence without turning uncertainty into false precision.

heroImage.alt: Three white clay iPhones showing Fritz Timeline, Today, and Patterns screens

role: Product strategy · Research synthesis · Interaction design · Brand system · iOS engineering

designSystem.name: Fritz Bright Steadiness
designSystem.summary: A native care system that combines warm consumer character with explicit evidence, stable capture, and calm next-step guidance.

principles.name: Current truth comes first
principles.description: The product leads with what is happening now, what confirmed it, and the next useful action—not a dashboard of abstract metrics.

principles.name: Preserve uncertainty
principles.description: Possible, inferred, approximate, corrected, and confirmed events remain distinct throughout capture, history, and analysis.

principles.name: Every inference explains itself
principles.description: Patterns disclose their evidence, exclusions, time window, confidence, and limits instead of hiding behind a score.

principles.name: Native means situational
principles.description: The app, notifications, dictation, and Live Activity each carry only the information appropriate to that moment.

principles.name: Encourage without judgment
principles.description: Language confirms the observation, explains its meaning, and preserves agency without streaks, guilt, or exaggerated praise.

typography.description: A friendly, sturdy voice gives the product character while remaining limited to the wordmark and major feature hierarchy.
Dynamic Type-aware system text keeps controls, timestamps, evidence, and everyday reading native and dependable.

components.name: Capture launcher
components.description: Stable quick actions and natural-language capture record common or compound events without making the caregiver reorganize the interface first.

components.name: Evidence status
components.description: Compact labels preserve confirmation, uncertainty, approximation, and changing confidence in both Timeline and Patterns.

components.name: Potty outlook
components.description: Independent pee and poop readings pair qualitative guidance with the observations, exclusions, and triggers behind it.

componentSnapshot.alt: Current Fritz Log, Today, Timeline, and Patterns screens presented in white clay iPhones on a warm stone background
componentSnapshot.caption: Current truth, event provenance, and explainable patterns share one native visual and semantic system.

productProof.title: One observation changes state, guidance, and evidence together
productProof.description: Today, Timeline, Patterns, notifications, and the Live Activity all derive from the same effective history, so a correction changes every downstream view without erasing what happened.

image.alt: A single white clay iPhone showing the current Fritz Today screen on a warm stone background

accessibility.title: Native behavior carries the expressive system
accessibility.description: Dynamic Type, VoiceOver order, 44-point targets, semantic status text, Reduce Motion, high contrast, light and dark appearance, and complete file protection are treated as product foundations.

internalNotes: Private household pilot and private repository. Public presentation must use synthetic scenarios and omit exported event data, family care details, veterinary information, licensed source-asset bundles, and breeder documents.
